newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's PDVSA launches own lubricants brand.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's PDVSA launches own lubricants brand.

text.p: State-run Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) launched on Thursday its own brand of lubricants, PDV, to be sold on the domestic market and in neighboring countries.
New sales and marketing subsidiary Deltaven is now in charge of selling Venezuelan-produced lubricants under the new PDV name, PDVSA announced at a launching ceremony.
First Latin American countries to be targeted are Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador and Peru. PDV is not meant to hit the U.S. market where PDVSA already has its Citgo brand.

Energy and Mines Minister Erwin Arrieta told reporters the idea was to take lubricants away from PDVSA's operational affiliates Corpoven, Maraven and Lagoven and leave them with their "core oil exploration, drilling and refining business".
